name: OPUS-100
description: English-centric massively multilingual corpus sampled from OPUS. 99 language pairs (all include English) with up to 2,000 test sentences each. NOT used for evaluation due to mixed/unknown licensing — OpenSubtitles component has copyright concerns and per-sentence provenance is not tracked.

source.citation: Zhang et al. (2020). Improving Massively Multilingual Neural Machine Translation and Zero-Shot Translation.

license.notes: Mixed/unknown licensing. Sampled from OPUS which aggregates many sub-corpora with different licenses. OpenSubtitles component has derivative work copyright concerns. Per-sentence provenance is not tracked, making license-compliant filtering impossible.

_provenance.reason_excluded: Mixed/unknown licensing with OpenSubtitles copyright risk. No per-sentence provenance makes license-compliant usage impossible.
